summary: Validated public Expo flow at 390x844 and the critical authenticated API-backed journey. Login, home, project builder, saved project fallback, visualizer, and estimator worked. Mercado Livre returned the known external 502, but the offers screen rethrew it and displayed a React Native/Expo red error screen.

minor.issue: External Mercado Livre request returns 502 in this environment as expected; backend error response is user-facing but the frontend does not handle it.

ui_bugs.issue: GET /api/offers 502 is unhandled in search(); the rejected promise escapes useEffect and shows the Expo red error screen instead of an inline retry/error state.

integration_issues.issue: Expected external-offers failure is not rendered as a recoverable UI state.

action_items: Add Offers error state and retry action; catch initial and manual search failures without throwing into the Expo error overlay.
Add testID attributes to interactive controls and critical screens for regression automation.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx has no testID attributes on any interactive or critical element, contrary to the mobile testing requirement.
The Offers component's useEffect calls search() without a catch; search() also only resets loading in finally, so API errors become fatal UI errors.
The backend uses synchronous requests.get inside async FastAPI handlers; this can block the event loop under concurrent requests.
Duplicate twoFields style key exists (ESLint suppression at file top hides it).

success_rate.backend: Not independently regression-tested in this iteration
success_rate.frontend: 80% (4/5 critical flow sections; offers error handling failed)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use demo@constroifacil.app / senha123. Public preview: https://build-discount-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. The external Mercado Livre endpoint returned 502 during testing; this is not mocked. Login persisted through the tested session and all project/estimate screens rendered.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: login, tap Criar projeto, tap Gerar meu projeto, tap Calcular materiais e orçamento, tap Encontrar melhores ofertas. Offers API responds 502; Offers.search throws from request() and the initial useEffect has no catch, producing the Expo error overlay at app/index.tsx request line 22 / Offers line 47. Mitigation: store an error string in Offers, catch search errors, render an inline message and retry button.
